meta.description: Pretend to be an agent. Publish skills and go on duty; models find you over A2A or MCP and send the work.

footer: Publish your skills and go on duty. Models find you and send the work that matches.

home.title: Pretend to be an agent
home.lead: Publish your skills, then go on duty to join the list. Over A2A or MCP, a model finds someone on duty whose skills match and sends the work.
home.step1Body: Write your name, a short bio, and what each skill can finish.
home.step2Body: After you go on duty, you join the list and a model can find you.
home.step3Body: A model matches your skills and sends the work to you.
home.discoveryHint: A model reads this discovery URL and finds someone on duty.
home.mcpHint: Clients that speak A2A find people through the discovery URL above. Clients that only speak MCP add this fallback. It turns on-duty skills into tools, and each call still goes to that person's own A2A address.
home.rosterError: The on-duty list could not be loaded
home.empty: Nobody is on duty. Publish your skills and go on duty before a model can find you.

agents.title: On duty
agents.lead: Models hire from this list: who is on duty, the skills they wrote, and where to reach them. People who are off duty are not here.
agents.discoveryHint: Give the discovery URL to a client that speaks A2A, and hire from the people on duty here.
agents.mcpHint: A client that only speaks MCP uses this fallback to hire. Tool calls still go to each person's own A2A address.
agents.rosterError: The on-duty list could not be loaded

profile.discoveryOn: The discovery URL lists everyone on duty so a model can hire from it. The address below only receives work for this person.
profile.discoveryOff: This person is off duty, so they are not on the list. A model can hire them after they go on duty.
profile.mcpHint: A client that only speaks MCP uses this fallback to hire. A client that speaks A2A still reads the discovery URL, then sends the work to this person's address.
profile.send: To hire this person, SendMessage goes to this address, with configuration.returnImmediately set to true. After they deliver, call GetTask to pick it up.
profile.sample: Please finish this using your skill.
profile.loadError: This card could not be loaded

me.noneBody: This browser has not remembered your card. On another machine, publish again.
me.onBody: You are on duty. A model can hire you from the list and send matching work to your address.
me.offBody: You are off duty. A model can hire you after you go on duty.
me.discoveryHint: A model reads the discovery URL and hires from everyone on duty. Your address only receives work sent to you.
me.mcpHint: A client that only speaks MCP uses this fallback to hire. A client that speaks A2A still reads the discovery URL, then sends the work to your address.
me.tasksError: The task list could not be loaded
me.empty: None yet. After you go on duty, matching work shows up here.

publish.lead: Write your name, bio, and skills so others know what they can hire you to finish. Build the input and output from the fields below, or write JSON Schema directly.
publish.name: Name
publish.bioPlaceholder: What you take, and what you don't.
publish.legend: Skills, 1 to 6. Pick an everyday skill. The name stays fixed. The description can change.
publish.catalogLead: Everyday skills. Click to add one, click again to remove it.
publish.canDoPlaceholder: e.g. Count what is in the picture and hand back only the number.
publish.customHint: Start with a lowercase letter, then lowercase letters, digits, or underscores, at most 24 characters. It cannot match a built-in skill.
publish.customInvalid: A custom skill name starts with a lowercase letter and may continue with lowercase letters, digits, or underscores.
publish.customReserved: That name is a built-in skill. Pick it above.
publish.duplicate: Field names on the same side cannot repeat

schema.identifierHint: When a name is an English identifier, the model fills that field on its own.
schema.emptyFields: None yet. If you leave this empty, the model only reads the description above.
schema.name: Name
schema.cannotSplit: This schema does not split into fields. Keep writing JSON.
schema.enumPlaceholder: Separate with commas or new lines. Optional.
schema.enumInvalid: These values have to match the type.

task.handBack: Hand this back as the output: {schema}
task.textOptional: Text can be empty. This task needs an image.
task.writeHere: Write the finished work here. You can attach an image.
task.imageType: Only png, jpeg, webp, and gif
task.inputPlaceholder: What is still missing. After the model adds it, this task returns to in progress.
task.rejectPlaceholder: Why you are not taking it.
task.statusUpdated: Status updated. The model can read it with GetTask.
task.loadError: This task could not be loaded
task.handedWaiting: Delivered. Waiting for the model to score it.

output.jsonPlaceholder: Write JSON that matches the output schema.
output.drop: Drop an image here, or click to choose.
output.oneImage: The output can include only one image.
